summary.en: Cards hang in 3D space, each with its own position, turn and scale; the camera flies from one to the next by taking the inverse of its pose, so the card it lands on is square and at 1:1.
summary.zh: 卡片散布在 3D 空间里，各有位置、转角和缩放；相机取下一张卡姿态之逆飞过去，落位时那张卡正对镜头、屏幕上 1:1。

fits: Chapters of one story laid out in space (step 1, 2, 3, then the overview); a product tour where the order matters.
notFor: Two unrelated scenes (there is no space to fly through); dense text on the cards in flight (they blur).

intent.en: Turning the page becomes travelling through a space of ideas: each card has its own place and angle, so arriving at it feels like entering a new chapter.
intent.zh: 把“翻页”变成在想法的空间里旅行：每张卡有自己的位置和角度，飞到它面前就像进入新的一章。

content.en: Wraps two or more cards (scene painters) and the pose of each; text on the cards stays short, since a rolled card is only readable once square.
content.zh: 包住两张以上的卡（场景画面）及各自姿态；卡上的字要短，侧躺的卡转正后才读得清。

fits.zh: 一个故事的几章摆在空间里（第 1、2、3 步，再到总览）；讲究顺序的产品导览。

notFor.zh: 两场毫不相关（没有空间可飞）；飞行中要读的密集文字（会糊）。

pairs.note: three flights with holds and an overview

en: Keep the text on rolled cards short: it only reads once the camera has righted it.
A title that hangs in the world is tilted in flight: fade it in after half the flight.
zh: 侧躺的卡字要短：转正后才读得出。
挂在空间里的标题飞行中是斜的：过半程再淡入。

upstream.name: 空间步进演示
upstream.summary: impress.js 式空间演示：卡片以不同位置/旋转/缩放散布 3D 空间，相机取各步姿态之逆依次飞行对齐，末步拉到 OVERVIEW 总览
upstream.use: 概念/路线图/三步法的空间化讲述；替代平面 slides 的"每一步都换个空间视角"
upstream.energy: 中（每次转场有空间惊喜，停留段安静读卡）
